subject: Civic Education
competence: Contributes to sustainable development adapting a bearable life style
unique_learning_outcome: Explains what is meant by a bearable life style.
Explains the need of getting used to a bearable consumption style in fulfilling day to day needs.
Expresses views accepting that the practice of such a consumption style contributes to sustainable development.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Explain the concept of bearable life style and its importance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Take notes on the definition and significance of bearable life style.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment check on understanding of bearable life style.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the need of getting used to a bearable consumption style.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and share views on the need of bearable consumption style.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on the benefits of bearable life style and its contribution to sustainable development.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present group findings and compare notes with peers.

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
